strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Endpoint DoS via Service Exhaustion Flood

analytics.name: Analytic 0489
analytics.guidance: High-frequency, repetitive service requests (e.g., HTTP, TLS renegotiation) originating from a single or small set of source IPs targeting endpoint web services or application ports, leading to exhaustion of CPU or memory on targeted Windows services.

tuning.description: Defines burst threshold (e.g., 1 min, 5 min) for connection spikes
Specific ports/services likely to be abused (e.g., 80, 443, 8080)
Level of sustained CPU usage considered anomalous for a given service

log_sources.name: WinEventLog:Application
log_sources.channel: Unexpected spikes in request volume, application-level errors, or thread pool exhaustion in web or API logs

log_sources.name: Windows:perfmon
log_sources.channel: Sustained CPU/memory exhaustion by service process (e.g., w3wp.exe)

analytics.name: Analytic 0490
analytics.guidance: Excessive inbound HTTP or TLS connections to services such as Apache or Nginx, causing worker thread exhaustion or segmentation faults.

tuning.description: Tunable count of specific HTTP error codes in timeframe
Defines number of connections per second considered anomalous

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: High frequency of accept(), read(), or SSL_read() syscalls tied to nginx/apache processes

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Sudden spike in incoming flows to web service ports from single/multiple IPs

log_sources.name: linux:syslog
log_sources.channel: Repetitive HTTP 408, 500, or 503 errors logged within short timeframe

analytics.name: Analytic 0491
analytics.guidance: Flood of incoming TLS or HTTP(S) connections to macOS-hosted services (e.g., MAMP, Apache), causing high CPU usage and system unresponsiveness.

tuning.description: Number of renegotiations per minute considered suspicious
Threshold of crashes before alerting on instability

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Web service process (e.g., httpd) entering crash loop or consuming excessive CPU

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Rapid incoming TLS handshakes or HTTP requests in quick succession

analytics.name: Analytic 0492
analytics.guidance: Automated or scripted HTTP/TLS flooding from one VM or cloud instance against another service, exploiting compute-based billing or exhaustion of service infrastructure.

tuning.description: Threshold for traffic burst on target service port
Compute saturation level for alerting (e.g., >90% for 3 minutes)

log_sources.name: AWS:VPCFlowLogs
log_sources.channel: Unusual volume of inbound packets from single source across short time interval

log_sources.name: AWS:CloudWatch
log_sources.channel: Sustained spike in CPU usage on EC2 instance with web service role
